info.title: Datumbox Universal API
info.description: Datumbox is a machine learning text-analysis API for language detection, sentiment analysis, topic classification, keyword extraction, text extraction, and document similarity.

get.description: Detects adult content in a document with Datumbox.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The clear text to evaluate for adult-content detection.

schema.description: The clear text to evaluate for adult-content detection.
schema.example: Enter the text to analyze for adult content.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

result.description: The adult-content classification label returned for the submitted text.

status.description: Datumbox success flag for the operation.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
